ctx.x: Well who are those they call the Confederate colonels? Little Cree, Armand Kay. Oh yeah, Armand Kay?
Yeah. What's Armand playing? Trumpet or bass? Trumpet. Trumpet? Yeah. Good. Where are they working? Barting around it? I guess. They had a job,

and the guy didn't come up with the money. Oh, one of them things, huh? Out on the highway? Yeah, I told you they were going to check. One of them no cash deals. Well, that looks like just about the end of the tape, huh, Paul? Okay, I'll just cut it.
